notes.title: Mini-patch: Screen shake toggling
notes.notes: Now that the high score contest is over, the game is updated with the ability to toggle screen shake on and off (rendering it easier to play).

notes.title: Controller support patch!
notes.notes:
In this patch aside from various bugfixes, controller support was also added. Controls are pretty easy to tell because when you plug a controller in, controller keys assigned to different ui elements appear.

Due to engine limitations you might need to play one round before the buttons appear.

Please have your desired gamepad connected before initiating the game.

XBox 360 controllers are guaranteed to have the best results.
